scripts.title: inf cash plus inf reb one script
scripts.features: inf reb and inf cash
scripts.script:
-- Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Args (empty)
local args = {}

-- Remotes to trigger
local remotes = {
    "addcashadmin",
    "rebirth"
}

-- Delay between each loop (seconds)
local LOOP_DELAY = 0

while true do
    for _, remoteName in ipairs(remotes) do
        local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(remoteName)

        if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            remote:FireServer(unpack(args))
        elseif remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
            local result = remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
            print(remoteName .. " result:", result)
        else
            warn(remoteName .. " is not a RemoteEvent or RemoteFunction")
        end
    end

    task.wait(LOOP_DELAY)
end

local LocalPlayer = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer

local premium, verified = true, true
local Index; Index = hookmetamethod(game, "__index", newcclosure(function(self, key)
    if self == LocalPlayer then
        if premium and key == "MembershipType" then
            return Enum.MembershipType.Premium
        end
        if verified and key == "HasVerifiedBadge" then
            return true
        end
    end
    return Index(self, key)
end))
